summary: Captures the problem statement for the Softwires Working Group, which developed standards for connecting IPv4 networks across IPv6-only networks and the reverse. It describes discovery, control, and encapsulation needs. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Old and new Internet address systems cannot talk directly. This note describes the problem of making tunnels so one kind can cross the other.

questions: how to connect ipv4 networks over ipv6
